description: This Java class defines a mapper utility 'ClientResourceMapper' that converts between 'ClientResource' and 'Client' objects, facilitating transformation between API resource representations and domain models.

classes.name: ClientResourceMapper
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to map between ClientResource and Client objects.

methods.name: mapToClient
methods.description: Converts a ClientResource object into a Client domain model object.

methods.name: mapToClientResource
methods.description: Converts a Client domain model object into a ClientResource suitable for REST API responses.
